name: M7.FinalSelector.raw_realizable
statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query), 0 < w → w ≤ N → M7.DefaultQuery.valid N q → ∀ c : M7.Action.Recipe N, M7.FinalSelector.RawFeasible w q c → ∃ x : M7.FinalSelector.Index N w q, M7.FinalSelector.realize q x = c
guidance: Use GeneratedFamily.family_complete at effective N q and QuerySectors.effective_valid. Raw feasibility supplies class validity and sectorTest: classSector directly provides an orbit signature witness; placementSector supplies the current signature and the identity action. QuerySectors.signature_allowed converts actual full signatures. No free complete-family premise. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.
